title: Mango Oatmeal Breakfast
summary: Creamy, naturally sweet, and such an easy toddler breakfast. ¼ cup rolled oats Peanut butter + honey (1 year+), optional Blend the oats, then cook with the water, flaxseed, and mango until thick and creamy.
caption: Mango Oatmeal Breakfast 🥭🤍 Creamy, naturally sweet, and such an easy toddler breakfast. ¼ cup rolled oats 1 cup water ½ tsp ground flaxseed ½ cup ripe mango 1 tbsp cottage cheese or Greek yogurt Peanut butter + honey (1 year+), optional Blend the oats, then cook with the water, flaxseed, and mango until thick and creamy. Let cool slightly and blend briefly with cottage cheese or Greek yogurt. Finish with peanut butter and honey or your toddler’s favorite spread. 🤍 ❤️ This recipe is just one of 200+ inside MunchMind.
